recipes.name: Apple Pie Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup Approximately of nonfat greek yogurt
1/2 cubes a tray of ice (about half a dozen)
instructions: Peel and core the apples. Take apple slices and place in blender. - 2 crisp apples (like Gala or McIntosh)

Add yogurt, spices, and ice cubes to blender. Place lid on blender and blend until smooth. - ½ cup Approximately of nonfat greek yogurt - sprinkle A of ground clove - sprinkle A of allspice - sprinkle A of nutmeg - sprinkle A of cinnamon - ½ cubes a tray of ice (about half a dozen)
Pour into a tall glass and drink with a straw.
